$schema_note: Per-floor encounter budget (task-004), closing the 'Encounter budget table per floor' item in RTS-VERTICAL-SLICE.md §4 / SYSTEMS.md §4. Population totals and composition are LOCKED from SYSTEMS.md §2 / economy.json (250/450/700) and scaling-curve.json (task-003, floor_roster / elite_boss_schedule) and are NOT re-declared as new numbers here. This file adds (a) procgen room-type budget spend, (b) main-arena arrival pacing (spike/lull), (c) an optional risk-room bonus pocket, (d) the entity-ceiling proof against docs/perf/BUDGETS.md, and (e) per-rank arrival-TIMING data derived from shipped Swarm.BroodSpawn*/BroodFormation.*/BroodSpeed CVar defaults -- the arrival/spawn-pacing data docs/sim/LIMITATIONS.md §1-§2 names as missing from every committed file and needed to test its wave-attrition model's candidate #1 gap. Decisions + rationale: docs/design/encounter-budget.md. Columns/units/ranges: encounter-budget.schema.md. rank_arrival_timing values are DERIVED FROM SHIPPED CODE DEFAULTS (cited exactly, not invented); every other table's values are PROTOTYPE DIALS, this doc's own judgment calls, unmeasured in-engine -- see design_constants notes for which is which, per row.

design_constants.pulse_lull_seconds_status: JUDGMENT CALL, this doc's own first-pass dial
design_constants.pulse_lull_seconds_note: Proposed Swarm.PulseLullSeconds. Gap between arrival pulses WITHIN a floor's Arena room -- a finer grain than the existing between-floor growth-site breather (SYSTEMS.md SS4/SS7, unchanged). Named Lull, not Breather, to avoid colliding with ERunPhase::Breather in Spike1GameMode.h, which already means something else (between waves, growth site). NOT derived from any shipped default -- a readability number to be judged by feel once pulses exist on screen.
design_constants.elite_lead_seconds_status: JUDGMENT CALL, this doc's own first-pass dial
design_constants.elite_lead_seconds_note: Proposed Swarm.EliteLeadSeconds. An embedded Elite spawns this many seconds before the rest of its pulse's swarm bodies, so its 1.8s swing telegraph (entity-tiers.json) has a moment to read clearly before it's buried in fodder (Design Law 6). NOT derived from any shipped default.
design_constants.risk_room_access_note: Risk Room is reachable only via a side corridor branching off the entrance-to-Arena corridor, and only before the Arena's first pulse triggers -- a 'scout the side room before committing to the fight' framing. This sidesteps any question of whether the Arena's pulse clock pauses while the player is elsewhere; it simply isn't running yet.
design_constants.rank_arrival_status: DERIVED FROM SHIPPED CODE, cited exactly -- see rank_arrival_source_cvars. This is the one block in this file that is NOT this doc's judgment call.

Swarm.BroodSpawnRadiusMin.role: Radius of the front rank -- the rank that leads the wave and arrives first.

Swarm.BroodFormation.RankSpacing.role: Radial gap between successive ranks; ranks step OUTWARD from RadiusMin.

Swarm.BroodFormation.Columns.role: How many brood share one rank (one arrival wavefront).

Swarm.BroodSpeed.role: Straight-line closing speed used for the travel-time estimate.

Swarm.BroodSpeedJitter.role: Per-brood speed variation at spawn; brackets the nominal arrival time (ArrivalSecondsFast/Slow).

retinue_formation_spacing_at_rest.source: GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md §3a MEASURED (Swarm.SpacingReport); same constant combat-model-constants.json's FormationSpacingUU already uses

design_constants.rank_arrival_formula: retinue_radius(N) = FormationSpacingUU * sqrt(N / pi)  [disk-packing footprint, same method combat_model.exposed_frontage() already uses in Scripts/sim/]. rank_radius(k) = BroodSpawnRadiusMin + k * RankSpacing. travel(k, retinue_N) = max(0, rank_radius(k) - retinue_radius(retinue_N) - FodderEngageRange). ArrivalSeconds = travel / (BroodSpeed * (1 +/- BroodSpeedJitter)).
rank_arrival_caveats: This is a closed-form Fermi estimate from shipped CVar DEFAULTS, not an in-engine measurement -- same epistemic status as SurroundCapEstimate/exposed_frontage() elsewhere in this repo, cited per-field rather than asserted as fact.

Treats the retinue as a point-plus-radius at the world attractor (Swarm->GetAttractor()), neglecting that the hero/retinue can itself be moving during the approach -- a static-formation snapshot, consistent with how the wave-attrition harness already treats both sides as pooled quantities.

Straight-line travel time only -- no steering/obstacle slowdown, no BroodSpawnArc/BroodSpawnFaceCamera bearing effects (irrelevant to radial distance, only to which direction the front rank appears from).
Assumes CVars stay at their shipped defaults; if any of the five is retuned, every ArrivalSeconds value here goes stale and needs recomputing from the formula above, not hand-edited.
